notes.title: Major update: version 1.2
notes.notes:
After months of coding, drawing, and testing, the third public steam version (1.2) is finally out.

I can't wait to see what you all think of this patch and all the new content. Reading all of your glowing reviews and comments has renewed my passion for this project. This should be the 2nd last update outside of smaller bug patches. I have a minor Halloween patch planned for next month, but you're here to read the changelog for this patch, so let's get into it.


Content:
15 new unlockable Steam achievements 

New explorable area: the apartments

A new ending

2 Secret nightmare sequences

New secrets and scares

New sprites for items and work minigame


Bugfixes:
Compilation error during dream sequence

Disappearing/oversized inventory sprites

Disappearing background sprites

Mom sprite not appearing at night

Dialogue edits

Restored non functional variables

notes.title: Lake of Darkness version 1.1
notes.notes:
Lake of Darkness patch 1.1
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673869/0a0009e3a7b644ad17c445c6ca4a1fdb12288157.png"]


Content:
2 new endings

new randomized dream sequence

new song in soundtrack (osttree)

expanded existing passive mechanics

more varied dialogue

more randomized events


Bugfixes:
missing sprites in corner store

certain hidden dialogue trees previously not appearing are now functional

No longer able to call into work past the time work is available

compilation error due to working twice in same day (no idea how this was missed during testing)

compilation error due to incorrect time in certain scenes

multiple compilation errors due to erroneous variables



Thank you so much to everyone for the amazing feedback and support since release. In this first major update I was hoping to focus more on polishing and fixing the existing content rather than adding new scenes. Don't worry however more updates will come regularly so keep an eye out for future announcements and releases. I'm looking forward to seeing what you all think of this most recent version, thanks again for following the development of Lake of Darkness.
